details:
I’m writing to you today because I’m passionate about playing VRChat. I think it’s fantastic that the game is available on smartphones, and it should definitely stay there! However, I would also love to see a version for one specific console: the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2. Modern smartphones with enough graphics power and RAM to run VRChat are extremely expensive. A game console, on the other hand, is a dedicated gaming device. It offers optimized cooling and powerful performance at a much fairer price. Plus, the controls on the Switch 2 would be perfect: you could use the left analog stick for movement, the right analog stick for camera control, and the buttons (A, B, X, Y) for jumping and opening menus. That would be far more precise than using a mobile screen, where your fingers block the view. It would be amazing if you released VRChat for the Nintendo Switch 2 as well. There is a huge community that would be absolutely thrilled about it! Thank you for your time, and keep up the great work with this amazing game ❤️ But please, keep VRChat on Nintendo and mobile devices for a long time—ideally forever.

Hello VRChat Team, I’m writing to you today because I’m passionate about playing VRChat and would love to see a version released for a specific platform. Since VRChat recently launched successfully on smartphones, I wanted to ask if you plan to bring the game to the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2? Unfortunately, the current Nintendo Switch was technically too weak for VRChat, but its successor will have significantly more RAM and processing power. This would be the perfect opportunity to port VRChat to a Nintendo console! There is a huge Nintendo community that would be absolutely thrilled to have "Flat Mode" on the console so they could hang out with friends there. Thank you for your time, and keep up the great work with this amazing game! Best regards, louis❤️🫶
title: Game suggestion: VRChat for the future Nintendo Switch
